query:
SELECT 
  MAX(cnt) as max_duplicates,
  AVG(cnt) as avg_duplicates,
  SUM(cnt) as total_records,
  COUNT(*) as unique_combinations
FROM (
  SELECT cardId, source, grade, soldAt, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM priceHistory
  WHERE cardId = 1020335 AND source = 'snkrdunk'
  GROUP BY cardId, source, grade, soldAt
) sub;
